verified_facts.summary: Canonical repository is JakeAIGO/JakeAI with default branch main.
Model continuity implementation is isolated on feature/model-continuity-router.
Continuity state validation, handoff generation, and four regression tests executed successfully in a local runtime.
Continuity now uses a rolling state plus append-only event journal so meaningful work is captured during long sessions rather than only in periodic handoff documents.

active_work.summary: Provider-neutral continuity layer is implemented and locally tested; rolling autosave policy and append-only event journal added to reduce context loss between providers.

next_action: Integrate the rolling event journal into the handoff generator so generated handoffs automatically include the most recent recorded events, then perform the external cross-provider acceptance test.
